Don’t be afraid to start over. There are few things as high-octane as playing a fantastic roguelike game with real consequences, and to celebrate a few of our favorites we’ve collected them all in this convenient roguelike games bundle! Mine for resources to build your home and fight monsters on an alien planet in Dome Keeper! Battle your way to the top in the adorably rabbit-themed co-op game Rabbit and Steel! Save the Twisted World from falling into chaos in the single-player deckbuilder Chrono Ark! And if you die, just start all over again! There’s even more fun to be had in this bundle of roguelikes, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Team Rubicon with your purchase!

Pay €5.11 or more. Normally, the total cost for the games in this bundle is as much as US$181. Here at Humble Bundle, you choose the price and increase your contribution to upgrade your bundle! This bundle has a minimum €5.11 purchase. Pay €5.11 or more to access Steam keys.

Redeem on Steam. All of the games in this bundle are available on Steam for Windows — and some for Mac and Linux too. Please check out the full system requirements here prior to purchasing.

Support charity. Choose where the money goes - between the publishers and to support Team Rubicon. If you like what we do, you can leave us a Humble Tip too!

battleshapers.callout:
81% Positive on Steam

A high-speed, sci-fi FPS roguelite set in a vibrant, futuristic world overrun by corrupt robotic Overlords. Steam Deck Verified
battleshapers.description_text:
About This Game

  • You play as Ada, a reactivated Shaper tasked with reclaiming New Elysium from the cunning Overlords and their corrupted robots. Using advanced weapons and unique abilities, you will shoot & smash your way through dangerous towers and defeat the Overlords to put an end to their corruption of the city.

Fight Laser With laser

  • Gun down hordes of enemy machines with relentless and punishing close-range combat in which every bot destroyed makes you stronger.
  • Face the Overlords and adapt to their evolving powers and tactics by mastering highly customizable weapons, movement, and combat abilities.

Build Your 'Core' Strength

  • Steal the Overlords’ Cores and harness their powers to craft and transform both your playstyle and appearance.
  • Unlock new weapons, abilities and talents to permanently increase your survivability and maximize your combat potential with every run.
Combat Is Only Half The Battle
  • Deploy your own traps, power-ups and hacks in each Overlord’s tower to turn the tides of battle in your favor.
  • Explore vibrant nostalgia-inspired locations to discover hidden upgrades and weapons throughout.
  • Be warned! Just as you grow stronger by defeating Overlords, the journey ahead will also become more challenging.
Fearless Shredding
  • Defy the Overlords and save the city to the might of adrenaline-pumping rock music that will have you diving head-on and fist-first into action.

chronoark.callout:
90% Positive on Steam

A story-driven party-based roguelike deckbuilder combining tactical turn-based RPG combat with deep card synergy crafting. Steam Deck Playable
chronoark.description_text:
ChronoArk is a party-based deck-building roguelike single player RPG game about rescuing the world from chaos.

Recruit, train, and build a team of unique investigators throughout the abandoned land and restore the Twisted World!

Features

Party-styled, card-based battles
Recruit up to 4 party members and synergize each card you have to win the battle!
All skills and perks will appear as cards during the battle.
It is up to you to customize your own characters!

RogueLite RPG
Unlike classic RPGs, everything you gain will reset when your party is eliminated. However, you will discover more options as you play through the game.

Storyline
A long time ago, the world was covered in the Black Fog and mankind evacuated to the Ark.
There is only one way to restore the world: collecting the Time Shades scattered around the Twisted Land and running the Clock Tower.
The world will return to its peaceful days if the Clock Tower starts to tick again…


‘Lucy’ ends up opening her eyes on the Twisted Land beneath the Ark.
Only thing she can remember is a mysterious message to operate the Clock Tower…
You will set up your Investigation Team with Lucy on a journey to gather the Time Shades.

Roguelike replays
12 collegues, numerous skill cards and items, relics, Lucy's unique skills, events, and bosses with patterns of their own.
Discover the Twisted Land, and complete your battle strategy!

Each move in ChronoArk is crucial as the battle mechanics are very seamlessly constructed.

You will face the forbidden truths while discovering the records inside of the Ark.

domekeeper.callout:
91% Positive on Steam

Mine beneath your dome to discover precious resources, ancient artifacts, and tech upgrades before the alien attack timer expires. Steam Deck Verified
domekeeper.description_text:
Defend your dome from wave after wave of monsters in this innovative roguelike survival miner, Dome Keeper. Use the time between each attack to dig beneath the surface in search of valuable resources and artifacts – use them carefully to choose powerful upgrades and bonuses. Set on beautifully crafted pixel art alien planets, Dome Keeper offers a captivating atmosphere, music tracks fusing melodic and synthetic creations together with a sense of wonder meeting the jet age that makes you want to come back for more.

Drill tunnels beneath your dome in search of precious materials or to uncover powerful hidden artifacts. Watch the time, you need to get back to the dome and be ready when the next wave of attack comes. How deep will you get this time? How much can you carry back?

Take control of your defenses to fend off the alien attacks. Air and ground, slow and fast; the attackers must be prioritized and dealt with before they tear your dome apart.

Utilize your mineral harvest to unlock powerful upgrades: augment your weapons, enhance the impact of your drill, boost your jetpack’s max speed, and many other upgrade paths -- each of which gives you and your dome the best odds for survival!

dungeonsofbloodanddream.callout:
93% Positive on Steam

Fight grotesque skeletons, slimes, and bosses using an array of bladed weapons, cursed rings, unnerving spells, and randomized potions.
dungeonsofbloodanddream.description_text:
Play as a mighty Blood Wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures using a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.

Gameplay:
Dungeons of Blood and Dream is a randomly generated dungeon crawler with roguelike elements in which the player will wield an array of bladed weapons and harness wondrous spells to fight through hordes of skeletons, zombies, slimes and other disgusting creatures that dwell in the dungeons. No two playthroughs are the same!

Features:
  • Procedurally generated dungeons filled with enemies, treasures, traps and secrets;
  • Many cursed rings with unique powers. Their effects change depending on what finger the ring is on;
  • Great many unique weapons, each with different effects;
  • Several NPCs to talk to;
  • Meta progression unlocks that remain inbetween playthroughs;
  • Randomly generated potions with effects varying from one playthrough to another;
  • Many enemies and bosses to discover;
  • Multiple endings;
  • Secret rooms, levels and areas with their own enemies and boss fights;
  • Lots of items, levels and features to unlock in game.

lostinrandom_theeternaldie.callout:
85% Positive on Steam

Play as Queen Aleksandra alongside her sentient die companion, Fortune, combining real-time action combat with tactical dice rolls. Steam Deck Verified
lostinrandom_theeternaldie.description_text:
A GAME OF CHANCE, A TEST OF SKILL
Lost in Random: The Eternal Die blends dynamic real-time action, tactical combat, and risk-reward dice mechanics for thrilling second-to-second battles.

Unravel an original stand-alone story as Queen Aleksandra, the once great ruler of Random on a mission for vengeance and redemption.

Wield an arsenal of four unique weapons, unleash powerful card-based abilities, harness elemental relics and strategically roll your trusted die-companion, Fortune, to shift the tide of battle. Or take on high-stakes wager games where the right roll could lead to incredible rewards… or crushing consequences.

Even death isn’t final - return to the Sanctuary to unlock new weapons, buy powerful upgrades, and take on quests from your allies to prepare for your next run.

A DARK FANTASY BROUGHT TO LIFE
Explore four dynamic biomes, each teeming with danger, secrets, and unpredictable challenges. Lose yourself in a haunting world of gothic whimsy, vivid landscapes, and an enchantingly atmospheric soundtrack.

With alternative endings to discover and a fully voiced cast of quirky characters, The Eternal Die invites you back into the world of Random for another unforgettable chapter.

KEY FEATURES
  • Fast-paced, second-to-second combat that blends real-time action with tactical decision-making.
  • A unique dice-roll mechanic that shifts battles in unexpected ways.
  • Four diverse and fully upgradeable weapons each with distinct playstyles.
  • 100+ elemental relics and 15 powerful card-based abilities to customise your build.
  • Four randomly-generated biomes filled with secrets, enemies, and high-stakes challenges.
  • 30+ unique enemy types and 4 ruthless world bosses, each demanding skill and strategy.
  • Randomly generated encounters, evolving relic synergies, and adjustable difficulty settings let you play your way.
  • A dark fantasy world brought to life in a Burtonesque style featuring hauntingly beautiful environments and an enchanting soundtrack.

front_page_art.image_text: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die

lostinrandom_theeternaldie.human_name: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die

otxo.callout:
95% Positive on Steam

A gruesome top-down shooter where you blast through an ever-shifting, supernatural mansion to rescue your lost love.
otxo.description_text:
OTXO (pronounced oh-cho) is a violent top-down shooter with roguelite elements. Play as the protagonist entering an inexplicable mansion in search of his lost love. As you venture deeper into the Mansion, more of its secrets will be unveiled to you.

Featureless, unnamed, and without memories of how you came here… but you remember why . She’s waiting for you somewhere in this Mansion and you cannot leave until you find her. Cut your way through various unique areas and meet new allies as you delve deeper into the mystery, face your inner demons, and annihilate them .

With a massive variety of guns, over 100 abilities, and Focus to dodge bullets at your disposal, kick down doors and eviscerate the variety of enemies standing in between you and your mission.

◼ Tons of replayability: OTXO will take the player through 8 areas with a randomly laid out selection of rooms out of the over 150 hand-crafted rooms built in the game. No two runs of the game will be the same.

◼ Customization: Find the setup that’ll help you break the cycle from a whole selection of unlockable weapons and over 100 acquirable abilities from the game’s enigmatic bartender.

◼ Playstyle: With the slow-mo mechanic, Focus, at your disposal OTXO will make the player feel powerful and in control. However, be careful because the variety of enemy types thrown in your way can quickly turn the tides of the combat if you don’t adapt accordingly.

◼ Soundtrack: Fully immerse yourself into the brutal noir-esque murder ballet through the gritty pulse pumping soundtrack composed by the developer himself.

rabbitandsteel.callout:
92% Positive on Steam

Journey through a magical fantasy realm as a heroic rabbit warrior, battling through dangerous boss gauntlets to uncover the source of a mysterious curse. Steam Deck Playable
rabbitandsteel.description_text:
STEEL YOURSELF

RABBIT & STEEL is a co-op action "raiding" roguelike focused around fighting challenging bosses alongside your rabbit-eared friends. Fight foes, gather loot, build your character, and work together to overcome obstacles on your way to the Moonlit Pinnacle.

Combat is deliberately similar to tab-target MMORPGs, being based around global cooldowns, effective skill usage, gear effects, and resolving boss mechanics through teamwork.

This isn't an MMO, though; it's a roguelike!

CHOOSE YOUR CLASS

Start a run, pick a class, invite friends to your lobby and you're raiding in seconds. Anywhere from 1 to 4 rabbits can embark together. If you venture out alone, mechanics that normally require cooperation will be replaced with intense bullet hell attacks.

Of course, it isn't always as simple as slapping down the enemies that stand in your way. Building your character with loot and upgrades you find along the way is key to success. Certain sets of items combo very well together... so make sure your allies don't roll on something you really need!

STORY

A few months ago, all contact with the Moonlit Kingdom was lost.
Reports indicate that the city's denizens attack outsiders on sight.
Investigative expeditions are repelled or go missing.
A colossal white tower now manifests in the city's center each night, stretching skyward towards the stars.
Something must be done. The rabbits will take care of this.
The night is short. Move swiftly.

FEATURES

  • Up to 4 players can play together locally, online, or a mix of the two
  • A plethora of bosses, stages, and challenging bullet-hell patterns to conquer
  • A single player story campaign where you chat up your enemies to uncover the mystery of the Moonlit Kingdom
  • Over 100 random loot items to power up your character
  • You can kill your friend by clipping them with a "spread" marker for laughs
  • Honestly they deserve it for rolling on the Darkstorm Knife even though they don't need it and it's SO good for your class
  • Supports playing with keyboard, mouse+keyboard, or with a controller

sourceofmadness.callout:
85% Positive on Steam

Battle ever-changing cosmic horrors whose body limbs, shapes, and attack patterns are generated dynamically using neural networks. Steam Deck Verified
sourceofmadness.description_text:
Source of Madness is a side-scrolling dark action roguelite set in the Loam Lands, a twisted Lovecraftian inspired world powered by procedural generation and AI machine learning. Take on the role of a new Acolyte as they embark on a nightmarish odyssey. Uncover the cosmic secrets of the Loam Lands and The Tower of Madness, the moon’s mysterious Citadel.

The horrific monsters you face are never the same, concocted with procedural generation and animated using a neural network AI

Explosive close-combat magic, labyrinthine environmental exploration, powerful loot management and a skill tree filled with abilities, classes, and spells

Rendered in a beautiful AI assisted art style, the fascinating world of the Loam Lands reveals a deep arcane lore as players uncover its many secrets

spellmasons.callout:
91% Positive on Steam

A turn-based tactical roguelike RPG centered around a deep, highly customizable spell-crafting magic system. Steam Deck Playable
spellmasons.description_text:
Spellmasons is a turn-based, tactical roguelike where you use your wit to blend spells and create new combinations. You can play solo or with friends in online co-op!


Discover Clever Combinations

The Spell System is deep and powerful : spells alter each other to allow for tons of creative possibilities.  For example: When you cast "Swap" on an enemy, the next spells in the combo will target your original location that you teleported away from so you can link nearby enemies together and follow up with a powerful damage spell that dispatches all of them at once!

Spellmasons rewards variation and creativity : spells get more expensive as you use them, and less expensive as turns pass, so you are encouraged to try new strategies often.


Explode your friends!

Work together with your friends in online co-op .  Save each other from near death or accidentally blow up each other!

Spellmasons features a unique “Faction-based” turn system where you and your friends can take your turn at the same time to keep the action going.


Specialize your magic

The Rune system adds a whole new layer to your magical potential by enhancing and specializing your magic.  If you want to be a Contagious Plague Mage who carries around curses so you can infect enemies wherever you go, you can do that.  How about a necromancer who creates copies of himself whenever he teleports and has a random chance to resurrect any enemy that he kills to fight for him?  Yup.  The possibilities are endless.


Challenging and Rewarding

Champion-ranked enemies provide an extra special challenge. They have modifiers such as “Growth” which makes them become stronger over time so you need to dispatch them quickly or “Slime” which gives them the ability to clone themselves.  Champions will make you think beyond your favorite strategies and come up with something new.


Uncover Secrets and Exploits

Find clever ways to push beyond your maximum mana to pull off ridiculously powerful spells.

Some spells combine in powerful and unexpected ways and the Discord community is always discovering new secrets.


Will I enjoy Spellmasons?

Spellmasons is a thoughtful, challenging, deliberate turn-based experience. Take your time, think creatively, and watch all of your plans unfold just like your diabolical little heart intended!
